about.p1: Sa7ne — صَحْني, meaning "my plate" in Arabic. Sa7ne is a ceramics brand dedicated to the storytelling of a homeowner through ceramic pieces. Every piece is handmade, customised, and curated so that each sa7ne piece is uniquely yours.
about.p2: Through it's collections of personalised dinnerware, Sa7ne personalises the act of hosting. It captures the personality and vocabulary of the dinner host and hostess — their colour sensibility, their warmth, their humour, their culture — and translates it into ceramic form. A table set with Sa7ne pieces is a table that could only belong to you.
about.p3: Sa7ne also helps homeowners visualise their tablescape through moodboards — composing Sa7ne pieces into a curated visual so you can see your home's story told before a single piece is made.

testimonials.text: The Blush Speckle Bowl is even more stunning in person. The glaze has so much depth — it's become the centerpiece of our dining table and the perfect salad bowl.
testimonials.name: Dima

testimonials.text: We ordered the Arc Leg Cake Stand for a birthday and it stole the show. So playful and well-made — guests kept asking where we got it.
testimonials.name: Faten

testimonials.text: The Rose Ruffle Platter is gorgeous for serving fruit. The handmade edges give it so much character — nothing like mass-produced pieces.
testimonials.name: Amani
